name: video-knowledge-graph
description: Reference implementation for semantic scene search and AI-generated video metadata on Azure.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vkg/shared && node --env-file=.env node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js "npm run dev -w @vkg/api" "npm run dev -w @vkg/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vkg/shared && npm run build -w @vkg/api && npm run build -w @vkg/worker && npm run build -w @vkg/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @vkg/shared && npm run typecheck -w @vkg/api && npm run typecheck -w @vkg/worker && npm run typecheck -w @vkg/frontend
